summary: Tested latest pricing/gallery/booking changes, full public lead flow, admin auth/dashboard/status workflow, responsive layout, and 19 backend API/security cases. Latest requested content is correct. Fixed and retested MongoDB _id serialization that broke dashboard status updates, plus whitespace-only lead validation. Final backend result: 17/19 passed; frontend functional flows passed. Two auth security controls remain unresolved.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout/rate limit: six consecutive invalid passwords all return 401; the sixth attempt should be blocked with 429 after five failures.
An arbitrary Origin (https://evil.example) receives Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; credentials are enabled and origins are not explicitly allowlisted.

issues: Supporting copy is stale: process text says 'Standard, Upgraded, or describe a custom project' and FAQ refers to 'Standard and Upgraded jobs' / 'Custom projects', inconsistent with The Standard, The Upgrade, and The Landscape tiers.

action_items: Implement per-account/IP login throttling or temporary lockout after five failed attempts and return 429 during lockout.
Replace permissive CORS regex/wildcard behavior with explicit trusted origins from configuration while retaining credential support.
Update stale process and FAQ package wording to The Upgrade / The Landscape.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS exists in backend environment configuration but server.py ignores it and uses allow_origin_regex='.*'.
Login performs password verification directly with no failed-attempt counter, rate limiter, cooldown, or lockout.
Admin seed logic does update an existing password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes, and the stored hash was empirically verified to start with $2b$.

Lead response models originally serialized the Mongo alias '_id'; this caused duplicate undefined React keys and PATCH /api/leads/undefined. Added response_model_by_alias=False to create/list/patch and verified status changes, refreshed stats, persistence, and filters end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional flows after in-scope API serialization fix

seed_data_creation: Created backend and UI leads prefixed TEST_QA_ for persistence/admin testing; cleanup fixture removed all TEST_QA_ leads after the final run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final pytest XML has only CORS allowlist and brute-force lockout failures. Latest pricing has exactly 3 cards and required copy; forbidden strings/caption are absent. Landing booking and admin status E2E passed after Lead responses were changed to emit id instead of _id. /app/auth_testing.md was absent, but credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_the_issue: The dashboard failure reproduced before the fix because BaseDocument.id aliases MongoDB '_id' and FastAPI serializes response models by alias by default; React therefore received no lead.id and sent PATCH /leads/undefined. Explicit response_model_by_alias=False resolved it. Remaining security failures are caused by permissive CORS middleware (allow_origin_regex='.*') and a login route with no failed-attempt state or throttling.
